endpoints.endpointName: Manton Avenue / Aleppo Street small-boat-launch access area
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: woonasquatucket_manton_aleppo_launch ridot-manton-aleppo-small-boat-launch: RIDOT identifies a small river boat launch where the greenway starts at Aleppo Street after Manton Avenue and lists Aleppo Street among public parking directions. The route coordinate is retained as a local launch-area anchor; RIDOT does not publish a site-level coordinate, so this is not a surveyed waterline.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (woonasquatucket_manton_aleppo_launch ridot-manton-aleppo-small-boat-launch) on Woonasquatucket River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.

endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ri_esmond_park_portage_access smithfield-esmond-park-portage-access: ExploreRI publishes the Esmond Park Portage coordinate and describes it as a site that can be used as a put-in or take-out but is primarily for portaging the small Esmond dam. The Town of Smithfield confirms the public Esmond Park, river frontage and parking. The coordinate identifies the portage/access site, not the exact wet edge.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ri_esmond_park_portage_access smithfield-esmond-park-portage-access) on Woonasquatucket River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
